init:
{{- if .Values.openclaw.feishu.enabled }}
        - name: init-feishu-plugin
          image: {{ include "mosaic-stack.image" .Values.openclaw.image | quote }}
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.openclaw.image.pullPolicy }}
          command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - |
              set -eu
              node /app/dist/index.js plugins install {{ printf "@openclaw/feishu@%v" .Values.openclaw.feishu.pluginVersion | quote }} --force
          env:
            - name: HOME
              value: /home/node
            {{- range $env, $key := dict "FEISHU_APP_ID" .Values.openclaw.feishu.appIdKey "FEISHU_APP_SECRET" .Values.openclaw.feishu.appSecretKey }}
            - name: {{ $env }}
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ $.Values.openclaw.feishu.existingSecret | quote }}
                  key: {{ $key | quote }}
            {{- end }}
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            runAsGroup: 1000
          volumeMounts:
            - name: openclaw-home
              mountPath: /home/node/.openclaw
        {{- end }}
values:
feishu:
    enabled: false
    pluginVersion: 2026.6.10
    domain: feishu
    existingSecret: ""
    appIdKey: FEISHU_APP_ID
    appSecretKey: FEISHU_APP_SECRET
    # Feishu open_ids (ou_...) allowed in DMs and approved groups.
    allowedUserIds: []
    # Empty disables group messaging. Entries are chat_ids (oc_...).
    allowedGroupIds: []
